title: CI/CD & IaC: The Power of Automation

scenes.say: Why do top teams automate their builds and infrastructure? What’s the real win behind all this CI, CD, and infrastructure as code?

scenes.label: CI/CD
scenes.sub: Build, test, and deploy code on every commit.
scenes.say: Continuous integration and delivery means every commit gets built, tested, and deployed—automatically.

scenes.title: Branch to Merge
scenes.say: You work on a branch, commit, push, and open a pull request. Code review and checks happen before merging to main.
With Terraform, you write code to describe cloud resources. Ansible configures servers. State files keep track of what exists.
Manual steps create snowflake servers and mistakes. Automation makes everything repeatable, reviewable, and easy to roll back.

scenes.question: Why keep Terraform state remote?
scenes.wrong: So you can run apply offline
scenes.right: Remote state is the single source of truth—no conflicts, no corruption.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Why keep Terraform state remote? It’s not for offline work. Remote state is the single source of truth, so your team avoids conflicts and corruption.
